assets.alt_text: Honey bees moving through a pollen-trap grid with detached pollen pellets visible on the collection surface
assets.caption: Pollen trap in use. Returning workers pass through the trap openings while detached corbicular pollen pellets are visible on the collection surface. A trap should remove only part of the incoming pollen and must be kept clean, dry and free of traffic blockage.
assets.credit: Photo by Matteo Giusti (Matteogiusti), CC BY-SA 3.0.

assets.alt_text: Close-up of collected bee-pollen pellets preserved by freezing
assets.caption: Frozen bee-collected pollen pellets. Freezing can preserve fresh pollen with little heat exposure when the product is collected hygienically and frozen promptly. These are bee-collected pollen pellets, not bee bread stored and modified inside comb cells.
assets.credit: Photo by Matteo Giusti (Matteogiusti), CC BY-SA 3.0.
